evidence.note: Jacob begot Judah and his brothers. Judah is the son named in this generation of the genealogy.
Leah says אוֹדֶה אֶת־יְהוָה, “I will praise Yahweh,” and names her son יְהוּדָה.

name: יִהֻודָֿא
summary: Matthew uses the Syriac name יִהֻודָֿא for Jacob’s son Judah. Genesis connects the Hebrew name יְהוּדָה with Leah’s praise of Yahweh at his birth.
